steps.note: Provide the mandatory event title.
Commit the 30-minute schedule described by the case.
Invite two QA vendors for Vendor A and Vendor B bidding.
Publish the auction event.
Verify that publication reached a real project page.
Submit Vendor A's initial bid of 100.
Verify that Vendor A's initial bid was accepted.
Submit Vendor A's revised bid of 85 using the same vendor.
Verify that Vendor A's revised bid was accepted.
Submit Vendor B's bid of 88.
Verify that Vendor B's bid was accepted.
Close the auction before reading the final QCS and awarding.
Open the comparison grid after bidding has closed.
Verify that the lowest auction amount ranks first among the two bids.
Verify that Vendor A's final rate is 85.
Verify that the QCS computes each amount and total from rate times quantity.
Award the closed event to the portal vendor that submitted Vendor A's bid, which is the 85-ranked bid.
Verify that the award proposal was created and submitted.
